title: Hook It Fishing Adventures

services.name: Hook It Fishing Adventures
services.desc: Gary has always been a threat on the tournament scene even as a beginner in 1999 he was awarded the prestigious Bass Mania Rookie of the Year award. He is the only angler to win the Canal Lake BM100 tournament with an all smallmouth bass creel as they are a specialty species for him. He has compiled numerous top 10 finishes in the Canadian Sports Fishing League Bass Mania tournament trail with several classic appearances. While recently in 2008 he was victorious at the Orillia Fall Challenge on Lake Couchiching where he took first place honors and weighed the biggest Smallmouth bass of the event! HOOK IT and let guide Gary Martins provide you with an enjoyable, educational and memorable day
